docs.title: Deploying
docs.text:
The site is built inside a Modal container image and served as a static site by a Modal web endpoint (see modal_app.py).

pixi run modal token new   # once, to authenticate
pixi run deploy

Modal prints the public URL when the deploy finishes. Run the same command again after editing pages to publish the changes.

For a temporary preview URL that updates live while you edit:

pixi run modal serve modal_app.py

docs.title: Run locally
docs.text:
pixi run serve

Pixi installs Python and mkdocs-material from pixi.toml the first time. pixi run build writes the static site to site/.

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8000. The page reloads as you edit files in docs/.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml        # site config, theme and navigation
docs/             # Markdown pages
modal_app.py      # Modal app that builds and serves the site
pixi.toml         # Python + MkDocs environment and tasks

docs.title: Writing pages
docs.text: Every Markdown file in docs/ becomes a page. Add it to nav in mkdocs.yml to place it in the menu.
